title: Understanding the Scatterplot
text: Observe the scatterplot carefully. Notice the pattern of the data points. Consider how the function $$f(x)=|x|$$ might fit this pattern.

title: Considering Absolute Value
text: The function $$f(x)=|x|$$ represents the absolute value of $$x$$. Think about how this transformation affects both positive and negative values of $$x$$.

title: Linear Relationship
text: Check if the data points can be aligned linearly by using the absolute value transformation. This would mean that the model can fit the data using $$f(x)=|x|$$.

title: Evaluating the Fit
text: Does the transformation $$f(x)=|x|$$ allow the data points to be represented linearly in the form $$y_i=\beta_0+x_i \beta_1+f{\left(x_i\right)} \beta_2$$?
